termsText: Grip socks are required in all classes (available for purchase at the studio). A 12-hour cancellation policy applies —

faqs.q: What's the difference between a drop-in and the intro pack?
faqs.a: A drop-in is a single class at €20, ideal if you already know reformer Pilates. The intro pack gives new clients their first two classes for €32 — a gentler, better-value way to learn the machine.
Flexi packs are valid for 2 months (5-class) or 3 months (10-class) from purchase. Monthly memberships renew each month.

faqs.q: Can I share a pack with a friend?
faqs.a: Packs are personal to you. If you'd like to bring a friend, they can start with a €20 drop-in or the intro pack.

faqs.q: What happens if I need to cancel a booking?
faqs.a: Cancel at least 12 hours before class and your credit is returned automatically. See our policies page for the details.
